notes: Cross-cutting (not PSI investigations, in data/raw/nasa): (1) ntrs-20000004509 (Olson and T'ien, Buoyant Low Stretch Diffusion Flames Beneath Cylindrical PMMA Samples): a genuine normal-gravity experiment paper: PMMA cylinders of radius 2.5 to 200 cm (Table 1, pdf page 28, ~8 stretch-rate rows) burning in air (text: 'full range of flammability in air'; ambient air density 1.176 kg/m3). O2 constant (air); pressure not stated (ambient implied); results in a table plus figures. Effort: needs reading. (2) ntrs-20150008961 (Olson and Ferkul, PMMA rods in concurrent flow, 2015): ISS BASS-II microgravity rods plus 5.18 s Zero Gravity Research Facility drop tests (excluded); the only 1 g items are general statements (1 g upward-spread limit 15.4 percent O2 with 4 cm/s forced flow cited from a reference); no 1 g test table. Overall: of the 18 investigations, only PSI-107 has a clean per-test 1 g table (SPICE, Dotson thesis Tables 6.3 and 6.4; O2 and pressure constant ambient air, not tabulated). PSI-25 has 1 g downward PMMA at 101 kPa / ~21 percent O2 but only as figures. PSI-99 has 1-g result columns with undocumented conditions. PSI-142 holds lab counterflow flame data without O2/pressure in the tables. PSI-101/102 ground tests are smoke particle sizes from heated samples (no flame, no O2/pressure). Drop-tower, KC-135 and ZGRF mentions (FLEX, FLEX-2, BASS, CFI, PSI-117) were excluded as not ground. Image labels 'ISS' and '1-g' (PSI-39 p3) and literature citations were not treated as ground tests. The pre-scan could not open one PSI-39 Analyzed Data PDF (FLEX-1248 Summary; flight data anyway).
